evidence_scope: Exact saved trajectory replay. Neither live parallel generation throughput nor autonomous retargeted policy performance is established by these videos.
concept_art: environment-concepts.png is AI-generated design research; it is not used as scientific action evidence.

flatten.sampling: state=min(4*((frame+phase)%850), terminal); source 50 Hz, output 25 fps
flatten.camera: 13-second hold, then smooth lateral out-and-back; same pose at the mathematical loop boundary.
flatten.scope: Presentation replay of independent saved trajectories. Not live parallel simulation or generation throughput.
flatten.geometry: Shared original PIPER rigid visual prototypes with independent true FK poses; main cloth Catmull-Clark, all other cloth uses original physical triangles without subdivision.
